Paul Schaaf <sch...@u.washington.edu> wrote:
>I am a little confused as to exactly how strikes are played in combat.
>Sometimes I have a card that I want to play if the other guy does not use
>a card, or sometimes the other way around. Is there a standard as to who
>chooses his strike first?...

The acting minion must choose strike first. Once chosen, the strike cannot
be changed in reaction to the strike the blocking minion chooses.
